name_input: M/S FINOLEX CABLES LTD; M/S FINOLEX CABLES LIMITED; M/S FINOLEX CABLE LTD.; M/S FINOLEX CABLES LTD.,; FINOLEX CABLE LTD; FINOLEX CABLES LIMITED; FINOLEX CABLES LTD.; FINOLEX CABLES LTD; FINOLEX CABLES LTD
court_cases: Indian Kanoon returns 615 documents mentioning Finolex Cables (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=Finolex%20Cables, checked 23.11.2026). The visible first page is dominated by tax/customs-excise appeals where the company is appellant (e.g. Finolex Cables Ltd vs Commissioner of Central Excise, Pune-I, CESTAT, 30.06.2015; Finolex Cables Ltd vs CCE Pune-I, CESTAT, 07.12.2010; Finolex Cables Ltd vs Commissioner of Customs and Central Excise, CESTAT Mumbai, 05.09.2003; C.I.T. vs Finolex Cable Ltd., Supreme Court daily orders, 28.04.2014) and by civil/IP matters: Finolex Cables Ltd vs Finolux Auto Pvt Ltd (Delhi HC, 12.07.2007, trademark, company as plaintiff); Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd vs Finolex Cables Ltd (Delhi HC, 18.09.2017, company as respondent); Finolex Cables Ltd vs Finolex Industries Ltd & Ors (Bombay HC, 24.09.2018, company as appellant) - the latter is part of the long-running intra-promoter family dispute. No NCLT/insolvency or criminal proceeding against the company was identified in the pages read; the full 615-document set was not enumerated, so this is not an exhaustive negative. Per project rules, litigation is not a rejection ground.
news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or SEBI penalty could be verified: the web_search backend was unavailable throughout this session (searx connection refused), and the company's own 'Credit Rating Certificate' page could not be located (several URL guesses returned 'Page Not Found'). The promoter-family dispute between the Chhabria factions (reflected in Finolex Cables Ltd vs Finolex Industries Ltd, Bombay HC, 24.09.2018) is a known governance matter but I could not open a dated news source for it in this session, so it is recorded as unverified context only. No regulator action confirmed.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS. The company's public site (https://www.finolex.com/, read 23.11.2026) describes only domestic Indian manufacturing (Pimpri, Urse, Goa, Roorkee) and domestic distribution; no export-to-Russia/CIS claim or record was located. Absence of evidence only - not a confirmed negative, since search tooling was down.
note: Sanctions: OFAC Sanctions List Search tool (https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/) is JavaScript-driven and returned no query results; the SDN.CSV export (https://sanctionslistservice.ofac.treas.gov/api/PublicationPreview/exports/SDN.CSV) was truncated by the fetch at ~6,000 characters, reaching only the alphabetical range up to 'F', so a 'Finolex' entry could be neither confirmed nor excluded from that file. UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List screens could not be run at all. sanctions_hit is therefore null = NOT VERIFIED, not a clean bill of health. Rating: null - not public/not retrieved in this session; do not infer a rating. Court cases: only the first page of Indian Kanoon results was read; the 615 hits are overwhelmingly tax and IP/civil matters, several of which the company won or initiated. Per Rule 2, sanctions/court/criminal matters are not rejection grounds - at most 'есть сложности'. No rejection basis identified in this session (no evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy was sought or found - that is outside this role's scope). Recommend re-running sanctions and rating checks when the search backend is restored.
